e-webhooks.10.evidence: With the catcher answering 500, five consecutive events: after failure 4 the hook shows is_active 0, fail_count 4 (observed: 1,2,3 then 0/4; the 5th event never fired because the hook was already off). Expected: disabled at fail_count 5. Cause: in do_dispatch the UPDATE sets fail_count = fail_count + 1 first and the CASE in the same statement then reads the already-incremented value and adds 1 again, so the threshold trips one failure early. Success reset works: after 3 failures one 200 set fail_count 0. The admin list shows a disabled hook as 'Disabled', last status code in brackets, failures count (seen for the 10.0.0.5 hook: Disabled, (0), 4). Product bug, off by one. Product code: jetonomy-pro webhooks class-extension.php do_dispatch lines ~523-535.

A member reply POST returned in about 0.05s while delivery is queued asynchronously. The 15s timeout itself is not observed on a real slow receiver.
